title: How OrthoCarolina Improved Its Ability to Connect Patients and Providers
summary: This Health Data Management article deep-dives on marketing as a growth lever at OrthoCarolina.
body_markdown:
#### From an[article published in Health Data Management](https://www.healthdatamanagement.com/articles/how-orthocarolina-improved-its-ability-to-connect-patients-and-providers/) on Nov. 15, 2026:


> Looking at the regulatory developments beginning in 2022, Blair Primis, OrthoCarolina’s chief growth officer, says, “You had a longstanding goal, and now a legal reason to do it as well” — to re-engineer that process of connecting individual patients to the correct specialists and subspecialists in the practice.


> “How do we best match the right orthopedic doctor or provider with the right patient? We can make sure an incoming patient sees someone who needs a particular specialist, for example, a knee doctor,” Primis explains. “And how do we deliver, with hyper-targetability, the best option for patients to choose a doctor? The easy thing would be to target patients based on their behaviors. But we needed a vendor partner to help us do it effectively, efficiently and in the right way.”
